pg_01_notebook.title: The Notebook in the Store Room
pg_01_notebook.description: The village keeper remembers a cloth-bound notebook that belonged to your grandmother. Find the loose pages in the store room and sort them out.
pg_01_notebook.summary: Sort grandmother's pages and take up her notebook.

objectives.text: Show the notebook to Pak Penjaga
objectives.text_id: Tunjukkan buku catatan kepada Pak Penjaga

hints: The pages are matched in pairs - look at the drawings, not the handwriting.
Two pages have a pressed leaf inside them.
The store room is inside the big house to the north.
pg_01_notebook.summary_id: Susun halaman-halaman nenek dan lanjutkan buku catatannya.

pg_02_keberangkatan.title: What to Carry
pg_02_keberangkatan.description: A traveller who has walked every region helps you pack for the road.
pg_02_keberangkatan.summary: Pack provisions with the traveller's help.

objectives.text: Meet the traveller at the village gate
Tell the traveller you are ready
objectives.text_id: Beri tahu pengembara bahwa kamu sudah siap

hints: A work day has an order: measure, cut, raise, tie, cover, sweep.
Nothing is tied before the posts stand up.
The gate is at the top of the village, where the path leaves the houses.
pg_02_keberangkatan.summary_id: Siapkan perbekalan dengan bantuan sang pengembara.

pg_03_net_mend.title: The Mended Net
pg_03_net_mend.description: The fisherman's net has torn. He will take your help - but he will not take a nail.
pg_03_net_mend.summary: Mend the fishing net and earn the village's travel letter.

objectives.text: Say goodbye at the village gate

hints: Nets are tied with twine and a shuttle; iron has no business in a net.
The mesh pattern is mirrored left and right.
The jetty is on the west side of the village, past the boats.
pg_03_net_mend.summary_id: Perbaiki jaring ikan dan dapatkan surat jalan dari kampung.

sm_01_kampung.title: The Carved Wall
sm_01_kampung.description: Aminah is repainting the carved wall of the rumah gadang and cannot remember where each panel went. Help her put the patterns back in pairs.
sm_01_kampung.summary: Learn the highland village and its carved house.
hints: Panels are paired by motif, not by size.
The house itself is north of the market square.
Stand close to the house until the journal entry is added.
sm_01_kampung.summary_id: Kenali kampung dataran tinggi dan rumahnya yang berukir.

sm_02_rendang.title: The Long Cook
sm_02_rendang.description: Ida is cooking for a wedding across the valley and needs the spice bundle finished and the pot watched.
sm_02_rendang.summary: Cook rendang with Ida for a village wedding.

objectives.text_id: Beri tahu Ida bahwa masakan sudah siap

hints: The spice bundle is on the market stall and the coconut milk is at the grinding shed.
Pound the aromatics before they go anywhere near the meat.
Coconut milk goes in after the spice paste, never before.
sm_02_rendang.summary_id: Masak rendang bersama Ida untuk pernikahan warga kampung.

sm_03_saluang.title: A Melody in Bamboo
sm_03_saluang.description: Bujang cut a flute blank and lost the song that went with it. Play it back for him.
sm_03_saluang.summary: Recover a saluang melody for the evening gathering.
hints: The flute blank is on the bench by the bamboo clump.
Press space (or click) as the note reaches the gold line.
The melody starts slowly and speeds up in the middle - do not rush the start.
sm_03_saluang.summary_id: Temukan kembali melodi saluang untuk pertemuan malam.

sm_04_ulos.title: The Cloth for the Wedding
sm_04_ulos.description: Sari is weaving and the loom is set up with the wrong pattern. She needs the weave laid out before the thread tangles.
sm_04_ulos.summary: Weave a cloth for the wedding and learn what the cloth means.
hints: The gold thread is with the trader at the market stall.
Thread is woven; plastic and paint are not part of a loom.
The pattern is mirrored top and bottom, with one line of light down the middle.
sm_04_ulos.summary_id: Tenun kain untuk pernikahan dan pelajari maknanya.

sm_05_talempong.title: The Wedding Music
sm_05_talempong.description: The elder has a talempong set for the wedding, but the players must be led. Learn which gongs to strike and when.
sm_05_talempong.summary: Learn a talempong part for the wedding procession.

objectives.text_id: Beri tahu Datuak bahwa permainanmu berhasil

hints: Watch which gongs light up, then strike the same ones.
There are five of them, from top left to bottom right.
The festival game at the square uses the same steady hand.
sm_05_talempong.summary_id: Pelajari bagian talempong untuk arak-arakan pernikahan.

sm_06_danau.title: The Cargo that Went into the Lake
sm_06_danau.description: A basket of goods slid off the trader's canoe. The villagers saw it drift - help the trader work out where it came ashore.
sm_06_danau.summary: Recover the trader's cargo from the lakeshore.

objectives.text: Return the cargo to the trader

hints: The lake is up the western road from the village.
The reeds are on the north side of the landing; the rocks are south.
North is towards the top of the search picture.
sm_06_danau.summary_id: Temukan kembali muatan pedagang di tepi danau.

sm_07_piring.title: The Harvest Dance
sm_07_piring.description: The dance troupe is rehearsing for the harvest festival and the newest dancer keeps losing the order of the steps.
sm_07_piring.summary: Learn the order of the harvest plate dance.

objectives.text: Find a pair of dance plates
Dance one round with the troupe
objectives.text_id: Menarilah satu putaran bersama kelompok tari

hints: A performance opens with a bow and closes with a bow.
The quick steps come before the most difficult part, not after it.
The plates are stepped on last - the plates are with the troupe, north of the square.
sm_07_piring.summary_id: Pelajari urutan tari piring untuk perayaan panen.

sm_08_pasar.title: Market Day in the Highlands
sm_08_pasar.description: The craftswoman needs her goods matched to the right stalls before the market opens, and she has something for you when it is done.
sm_08_pasar.summary: Set up the market and take the road east.

objectives.text: Sort the goods to the stalls
Walk the market street at first light

hints: Thread belongs with weaving, chilli with spices, bronze with music.
The market is at the eastern end of the village.
Coffee is dried, not woven - it goes to the drying yard.
sm_08_pasar.summary_id: Tata pasar dan tempuh jalan ke timur.

jv_01_tumpeng.title: The Cone of Yellow Rice
jv_01_tumpeng.description: The cook is preparing tumpeng for a thanksgiving gathering and the rice keeps collapsing into a lump.
jv_01_tumpeng.summary: Cook tumpeng for the village thanksgiving.

objectives.text: Present the tumpeng to the cook

hints: Turmeric is what makes the rice yellow; without it the cone is just rice.
Rice is steamed before it is shaped - wet rice will not stand up.
The side dishes are arranged after the cone stands, not before.

jv_02_batik.title: Wax and Dye
jv_02_batik.description: A batik maker needs the wax pen warmed and the pattern drawn before the dye bath is ready.
jv_02_batik.summary: Draw a batik pattern and learn how wax resists dye.

objectives.text: Show the cloth to the batik maker
objectives.text_id: Tunjukkan kain itu kepada perajin batik

hints: Wax goes on the cloth cold-looking and molten-hot; it blocks the dye.
The wax block is at the workshop and the pen is with the trader.
The pattern repeats diagonally with filled corners.
jv_02_batik.summary_id: Gambar motif batik dan pelajari cara malam menahan pewarna.

jv_03_gamelan.title: Bronze Voices
jv_03_gamelan.description: Ki Bagus is rehearsing the gamelan for the temple anniversary and needs a player who can keep time.

objectives.text: Ask Ki Bagus about the tuning
objectives.text_id: Tanyakan laras gamelan kepada Ki Bagus

hints: Watch the drum; the whole ensemble follows it.
The notes come in groups of four.
You may miss a stroke - the rehearsal will not stop for you.

jv_04_sawah.title: Water for the Terrace
jv_04_sawah.description: The irrigation gate has jammed and the lower terrace is drying out. Pak Tarno is up the hill with the other farmers.
jv_04_sawah.summary: Open the water for the lowest terrace.

objectives.text: Turn the channels to the lowest field
objectives.text_id: Atur saluran agar air mencapai sawah terbawah

objectives.text: Carry seedlings to the lower field
objectives.text_id: Bawakan bibit padi ke petak bawah

hints: The spring is at the top left of the field map.
Two channels must meet before any water can flow on.
The dry field is the bottom right corner.
jv_04_sawah.summary_id: Alirkan air ke petak sawah paling bawah.

jv_05_wayang.title: Behind the Screen
jv_05_wayang.description: The old puppeteer cannot perform tonight unless someone can answer his questions about the stories.
jv_05_wayang.summary: Answer the puppeteer's questions about wayang.

objectives.text: Sit with Mbah Karto for the story
objectives.text_id: Duduk bersama Mbah Karto mendengarkan cerita

hints: Think about where the lamp is and where the audience sits.
The puppets are in front of the screen; the shadows fall on the other side.
The performance traditionally runs all night.

jv_06_angklung.title: One Note Each
jv_06_angklung.description: Rara is teaching a group of children angklung, and the group keeps falling apart because nobody waits their turn.
jv_06_angklung.summary: Play angklung with the village children.

objectives.text: Take part in the group game
Tell Rara the group is ready
objectives.text_id: Beri tahu Rara bahwa kelompok sudah siap

hints: Each instrument makes one note, so the music only exists when many people play.
Agree the beat before anybody shakes anything.
Everyone stops together at the signal.

jv_07_candi.title: The Stepped Mountain
jv_07_candi.description: Dewi is copying the relief panels of the old temple for the museum and one panel row is out of order.
jv_07_candi.summary: Reconstruct the temple panel row and walk the galleries.
hints: Click a panel to turn it a quarter; none of them need to move.
Fix the top row first and then leave it alone.
The galleries are walked clockwise, with the temple shape as the story.
jv_07_candi.summary_id: Susun kembali panel candi dan telusuri galeri-galerinya.

jv_08_pasar_java.title: Before the Market Closes
jv_08_pasar_java.description: The trader's stall list is muddled and the market closes before noon. Sort the stalls, and the trader will point you to the crossing south.
jv_08_pasar_java.summary: Sort the morning market and take the road south.

objectives.text: Match the stalls to their goods

hints: Rice in a cone belongs to a food stall, wax to a batik stall.
The padded mallet is used on bronze, not on cloth.
The village hall is at the north end, where the gamelan is kept.
jv_08_pasar_java.summary_id: Pilah barang-barang pasar pagi dan tempuh jalan ke selatan.

kl_01_rumah_panjang.title: The Long Roof
kl_01_rumah_panjang.description: A storm took the roof panels off the longhouse gallery. Lasan is re-plaiting them and needs another pair of hands.
kl_01_rumah_panjang.summary: Repair the longhouse roof and learn how it is shared.
hints: Rattan is soaked first so that it bends instead of cracking.
The panel has a hollow centre and a complete outer ring.
The gallery runs the whole length of the house.
kl_01_rumah_panjang.summary_id: Perbaiki atap rumah panjang dan pelajari cara warga berbagi ruang.

kl_02_karungut.title: A Sung Story
kl_02_karungut.description: Tina is learning karungut - sung verses - and cannot hold the pulse through a long phrase.
kl_02_karungut.summary: Learn the pulse of a sung verse.

objectives.text: Keep the pulse of the verse
Sing a verse back to Tina

hints: A sung story runs on a steady pulse - follow the drum, not your breath.
The phrases are short, with a longer pause between them.
You may miss a syllable and still finish the verse.

kl_03_sungai.title: The Blocked Channel
kl_03_sungai.description: A fallen tree is damming a side channel and the boats cannot reach the landing. The channel pieces must be turned so the flow finds its way again.
kl_03_sungai.summary: Clear the channel so the river reaches the landing.

objectives.text: Tell Bapa Udi the boats can come
objectives.text_id: Beri tahu Bapa Udi bahwa perahu bisa datang

hints: The channel starts on the left bank, halfway up the map.
A channel pointing away from the next one blocks the whole line.
The landing is just above the middle of the right edge.
kl_03_sungai.summary_id: Buka saluran agar sungai kembali mengalir ke dermaga.

kl_04_sasirangan.title: Tied and Dyed
kl_04_sasirangan.description: Rini is dyeing cloth for the river festival and one batch came out wrong because the ties were placed at random.
kl_04_sasirangan.summary: Tie and dye a cloth the Banjar way.

objectives.text_id: Tunjukkan kain yang sudah dicelup kepada Rini

hints: The ties form a ring around the middle of the cloth.
Two of the tied squares sit in opposite corners.
Count eight ties - not six, not ten.
kl_04_sasirangan.summary_id: Ikat dan celup kain dengan teknik Banjar.

kl_05_bengkel.title: Tools of the Workshop
kl_05_bengkel.description: The craftsperson's workbench was knocked over and every tool has to be paired with its partner before the day's work can start.
kl_05_bengkel.summary: Sort the workshop tools and learn what a mandau is for.

objectives.text: Ask the craftsperson about the blade

hints: Each tool has exactly one twin on the bench.
Six pairs, twelve items - work across a row at a time.
The blade and its sheath belong together.
kl_05_bengkel.summary_id: Pilah perkakas bengkel dan pelajari kegunaan mandau.

kl_06_soto.title: Soto from the River Market
kl_06_soto.description: The cook at the floating market is short-handed and the spice pot is about to boil over.
kl_06_soto.summary: Cook soto for the river market.
hints: Broth first, whole spices second, lime only in the bowl.
The whole spices are fished out before serving.
The floating market is east along the water, past the long jetty.

kl_07_pasar_logic.title: Which Boat Carries the Salt?
kl_07_pasar_logic.description: Three boats lie at the landing and the trader's salt is on one of them. The boatmen will not say which.
kl_07_pasar_logic.summary: Work out which boat carries the salt.

objectives.text: Work out which boat carries the salt
objectives.text_id: Cari tahu perahu mana yang membawa garam

objectives.text: Tell the trader where the salt is
objectives.text_id: Beri tahu pedagang di mana garamnya

hints: The boat at the far end has only one neighbour.
Boat A carries fruit, so the salt is not in A.
Ask who is moored beside A.
kl_07_pasar_logic.summary_id: Cari tahu perahu mana yang membawa garam.

kl_08_gantar.title: The Planting Dance
kl_08_gantar.description: The dancers are preparing a gantar for the planting season and the order of the movements keeps getting mixed up.
kl_08_gantar.summary: Learn the planting dance and take the river road north.

objectives.text: Dance the gantar with the troupe

hints: Nothing is planted before the ground is cleared; start there.
Seed goes into a hole, never on top of the soil.
The last movement presses the earth down over the seed.
kl_08_gantar.summary_id: Pelajari tari menanam dan tempuh jalur sungai ke utara.

sl_01_tongkonan.title: The Saddle Roof
sl_01_tongkonan.description: The gable of the ancestral house is being recarved and the panels have to be turned the right way before the feast.
sl_01_tongkonan.summary: Help restore the gable of the ancestral house.
hints: Fix a row at a time and leave it alone once it is right.
Each turn of a panel is a quarter turn; none of them move.
The house faces north, and the gable is above the door.

sl_02_phinisi.title: A Ship Without Nails
sl_02_phinisi.description: The shipwright is laying the planking of a new hull and needs someone to check the curve pattern before the pegs go in.
sl_02_phinisi.summary: Lay out the planks of a wooden ship.

objectives.text_id: Tunjukkan tata letaknya kepada pembuat kapal

hints: No iron goes into a wooden hull - not one nail.
The pattern narrows towards the keel and widens at the deck line.
The bottom row is two separate points, not a solid line.
sl_02_phinisi.summary_id: Susun papan-papan untuk membuat kapal kayu.

sl_03_kolintang.title: Wooden Bars and Mallets
sl_03_kolintang.description: Rambu's kolintang group is one player short for a wedding, and the new player keeps striking the wrong bars.
sl_03_kolintang.summary: Learn a kolintang part for a wedding.

objectives.text: Tell Rambu the group is ready
objectives.text_id: Beri tahu Rambu bahwa kelompok sudah siap

hints: Watch the four bars that light up - they form a square in the middle.
You may strike them in any order once you remember them.
The spare bar is at the workshop behind the church.

sl_04_coto.title: Coto for the Harbour
sl_04_coto.description: The harbour cook has a queue of dockworkers and one pot of coto left to finish.
sl_04_coto.summary: Cook coto makassar for the harbour crowd.
hints: Peanut is what thickens the broth; it goes in grated, not whole.
Spices are added after the meat is tender, never before.
Stop the boil while the marker is inside the golden band.
sl_04_coto.summary_id: Masak coto Makassar untuk warga pelabuhan.

sl_05_pakarena.title: The Unhurried Dance
sl_05_pakarena.description: The dancers are rehearsing a Makassar welcome dance and the new dancers keep speeding up against the drum.
sl_05_pakarena.summary: Learn to follow the drum in a Makassar dance.

objectives.text: Ask the dancer about the pace

hints: The drum leads; you follow it. There is no counted beat.
The beats come in pairs with a gap between them.
Slow is correct - the dance is deliberately unhurried.
sl_05_pakarena.summary_id: Pelajari cara mengikuti gendang dalam tari Makassar.

sl_06_lontara.title: The Palm Leaf Archive
sl_06_lontara.description: The teacher is sorting old palm-leaf records and one strip cannot be identified.
sl_06_lontara.summary: Sort the old records in the village archive.

objectives.text: Return the strip to the teacher

hints: Compare the lengths of the strips before the marks on them.
The double mark appears on one record only.
Whatever remains is the land record.
sl_06_lontara.summary_id: Pilah catatan lama di arsip kampung.

sl_07_bajo.title: Where the Fish Are
sl_07_bajo.description: The stilt village has had two empty mornings. The fishers' reports need reading to find where the fish have moved.
sl_07_bajo.summary: Find the fishing ground from the fishers' reports.
hints: West is the left side of the map and north is up.
Fish were seen where the reef meets the deep channel.
The channel runs south of the village, so the ground is between the two.
sl_07_bajo.summary_id: Temukan lokasi menangkap ikan dari laporan para nelayan.

sl_08_pelabuhan.title: Ports and Cargo
sl_08_pelabuhan.description: The last thing before the eastern crossing: the trader's cargo ledger has to be matched to the ports it came from.
sl_08_pelabuhan.summary: Sort the harbour ledger and take ship east.

objectives.text: Match each cargo to its port
Close the ledger with the trader

hints: Silk comes from where it is woven, ships from where they are built.
Sago travels by boat; it does not come down a mountain road.
Each answer names a place you have already stood in.
sl_08_pelabuhan.summary_id: Pilah buku muatan pelabuhan dan berlayarlah ke timur.

pp_01_honai.title: A House for the Cold Nights
pp_01_honai.description: The nights in the valley are cold and the thatch on the small house has to be rebuilt before the rains.
pp_01_honai.summary: Rebuild the roof of a round highland house.
hints: A honai roof is a cone of thatch - thick at the base and narrow at the top.
The pattern widens with every row.
The lowest three rows are filled in completely.
pp_01_honai.summary_id: Bangun kembali atap rumah bundar di dataran tinggi.

pp_02_noken.title: The Knotted Bag
pp_02_noken.description: Mama Lena is making a noken and the knots have to be paired exactly, or the bag will not stretch evenly.
pp_02_noken.summary: Learn the knots of a noken bag.
hints: Six knots, twelve cards - each knot has exactly one twin.
Work across the top row first, then down.
The fibre is in the smoke rack above the hearth.

pp_03_papeda.title: Sago and Fish
pp_03_papeda.description: Petrus is cooking papeda for the whole family and the sago has to go into the water at exactly the right moment.
hints: Sago thickens all at once if the starch goes in too fast - stir while you pour.
The fish soup simmers while the sago is being stirred.
The sago is at the smoke rack and the fish is at the drying rack by the river.

pp_04_tifa.title: Drum Call
pp_04_tifa.description: Tomas is carving a drum body and needs the call pattern again in his hands before the evening gathering.
pp_04_tifa.summary: Learn the drum call for the evening gathering.
hints: The call starts at the top corner and closes at the bottom.
Six strikes, not eight - count them as they light up.
Answer in any order; only the set of strikes matters.
pp_04_tifa.summary_id: Pelajari panggilan gendang untuk pertemuan malam.

pp_05_lembah.title: Watering the Gardens
pp_05_lembah.description: The teacher is showing the garden ditches to the children, and one channel is turned the wrong way.
pp_05_lembah.summary: Open the ditch to the sweet potato beds.
hints: The stream enters near the top edge, one column across from the corner.
These gardens are drained, not flooded; the ditch must keep running.
The beds are in the bottom row, middle column.
pp_05_lembah.summary_id: Buka parit menuju bedengan ubi jalar.

pp_06_sentani.title: Something by the Lake
pp_06_sentani.description: A canoe has gone missing on the lake and the villagers' directions disagree.
pp_06_sentani.summary: Find the missing canoe by the lake.

objectives.text: Mark the place on the shore
Tell the village the canoe is safe
objectives.text_id: Beri tahu warga kampung bahwa kano aman

hints: North is up on the search map, east is right.
Start at the old canoe, then move east to the painted stones.
The drying racks stand between the stones and the water.
pp_06_sentani.summary_id: Temukan kano yang hilang di dekat danau.

pp_07_kulit_kayu.title: Beaten Cloth
pp_07_kulit_kayu.description: Mama Lena is making bark cloth and the sheet must be beaten flat before it dries, or the whole morning is wasted.
pp_07_kulit_kayu.summary: Make bark cloth from start to finish.

objectives.text: Order the steps of making bark cloth
objectives.text_id: Susun urutan pembuatan kain kulit kayu

objectives.text: Show Mama Lena the finished sheet
objectives.text_id: Tunjukkan kain yang sudah jadi kepada Mama Lena

hints: Bark is soaked before it is beaten, never the other way round.
The sheet is dried flat; if it curls, it cannot be painted.
Painting is the last step of all.
pp_07_kulit_kayu.summary_id: Buat kain kulit kayu dari awal hingga selesai.

pp_08_burung.title: Watching, Not Catching
pp_08_burung.description: A bird watcher has been in the forest since before dawn and needs help reading the notes they brought back.
pp_08_burung.summary: Identify a bird from the watchers' notes.

objectives.text: Work out which bird was seen
objectives.text_id: Cari tahu burung mana yang terlihat

hints: The notes are about behaviour, not about catching anything.
One bird displays at dawn and folds its plumes into a fan.
Choose the bird the notes describe.
pp_08_burung.summary_id: Kenali burung dari catatan para pengamat.

pp_09_jejak.title: The Keeping of Records
pp_09_jejak.description: Before the notebook is closed, the village keeper has one last test: everything you have recorded, asked back to you.
pp_09_jejak.summary: Pass the final test and close the notebook.

objectives.text: Close the notebook with the keeper
objectives.text_id: Tutup buku catatan bersama penjaga kampung

hints: Every question comes from something a person told you along the road.
You may retry the test as many times as you like - it is a test, not a gate.
The keeper will not ask about anything you never heard.
pp_09_jejak.summary_id: Lalui ujian terakhir dan tutup buku catatan.
